PREFIX wd:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd:  <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

SELECT ?placeLabel ?adminLabel WHERE {
  VALUES ?name { "Kos"@fr "Ksibet el-Médiouni"@fr "La Manouba"@fr "M'saken"@fr "Mahboubine"@fr "Marseille"@fr "Maubeuge"@fr "Medjez el-Bab"@fr "Menzel Hayet"@fr "Metline"@fr "Mezzouna"@fr "Moldavie"@fr }
  ?place rdfs:label ?name .
  ?place wdt:P17 wd:Q948 .          # in Tunisia: excludes Moroccan namesakes
  ?place wdt:P131+ ?admin .
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "fr,en". }
}

SELECT ?place ?placeLabel ?admin ?adminLabel ?countryLabel WHERE {
  VALUES ?name { "6e arrondissement de Paris"@fr "Akouda"@fr "Bekalta"@fr "Beni Khedache"@fr "Bou Arada"@fr "Bou Salem"@fr "Bouhjar"@fr "Béni Khalled"@fr "Béni Khiar"@fr "Caucase"@fr "Chenini"@fr "Circassie"@fr }
  ?place rdfs:label ?name .
  ?place wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q486972 .        # human settlement
  OPTIONAL { ?place wdt:P131+ ?admin . ?admin wdt:P31 wd:Q192287 }   # governorate of Tunisia
  OPTIONAL { ?place wdt:P17 ?country }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "fr,en". }
}
